topics.title: How Do Bacteria Communicate?
topics.learning_objective: Understand how bacteria use chemical signals to communicate and coordinate behavior.

topics.title: What Is a Biofilm, and Why Does It Matter?
topics.learning_objective: Learn what biofilms are and their significance in health, industry, and the environment.

topics.title: How Do Antimicrobial Resistance Genes Spread?
topics.learning_objective: Explore how bacteria share genes that make them resistant to antibiotics through horizontal gene transfer.

topics.title: What Are the Differences Between Viruses and Bacteria?
topics.learning_objective: Compare and contrast viruses and bacteria in terms of structure, reproduction, and impact on health.

topics.title: How Do Microbes Help Break Down Plastic?
topics.learning_objective: Discover how certain microbes can degrade plastic waste through specialized enzymes.

topics.title: What Is the Role of Endospores in Bacterial Survival?
topics.learning_objective: Understand how endospores allow bacteria to survive extreme environmental conditions.

topics.title: How Do Microbes Influence Human Digestion?
topics.learning_objective: Explore the role of gut microbiota in digestion, immunity, and overall health.

topics.title: What Are Probiotics, and How Do They Work?
topics.learning_objective: Learn how probiotics support digestive health by balancing gut bacteria.

topics.title: How Do Microbes Contribute to Climate Change?
topics.learning_objective: Discover the role of microbes in carbon cycling and their impact on greenhouse gas emissions.

topics.title: What Is a Lysogenic Cycle, and How Does It Work?
topics.learning_objective: Understand how bacteriophages integrate into bacterial DNA during the lysogenic cycle.
